# CG-RES-026: Response property became write-only

A response property gained writeOnly.

**Why it matters:** A returned field stops being returned.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.accessChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Property "{property}" became write-only in {where}.
>
> Write-only properties are not returned, so consumers reading "{property}" will not find it.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the property readable, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: optional password becomes write-only

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {password: {type: string}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {password: {type: string, writeOnly: true}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. Property "password" became write-only in GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Fires: required password becomes write-only

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [password], properties: {password: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [password], properties: {password: {writeOnly: true}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Property "password" became write-only in GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Does not fire: request direction

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {password: {type: string}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {password: {type: string, writeOnly: true}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
